_comment: Every LIVE file that writes a book page counter (pages_count, pages_ocr, pages_translated,
pages_translatable, pages_blank, pages_archived) other than recountBook() in
scripts/lib/page-counts.mjs / src/lib/page-counts.ts. Importing page-counts no longer
exempts a file: a file that counts canonically but writes a SUBSET still makes two
definitions alternate on live books (#5325, .claude/docs/page-counts.md).
This list is a RATCHET, not an approval. tests/unit/page-counter-writers.test.ts
asserts it never GROWS and that every entry still writes. Remove an entry by making the
file call recountBook() — never by regenerating this file to make a new offender
disappear. Burn-down: #5326 (reconciler), #5327 (live writers), #5328 (creation),
#5329 (one-off scripts); tracking #4499.
2026-09-30 (#5325): rebuilt from the design's appendix of live writers (66, less
recount-page-stats.mjs, converted in the same PR) plus three the appendix missed and the
widened scanner found: scripts/lib/translate-core.mjs (syncBookTranslationCounters,
hoisted $set, subset), scripts/workers/batch-split-bph.mjs (hoisted setDoc, private
count) and src/lib/uploads/utils.ts (hoisted, counts ALL pages including soft-hidden).
2026-10-01 (#5326): scripts/workers/sync-worker.mjs left — the reconciler writes through
recountSet() from page-counts, all six counters or none.
2026-10-13 (#5327, archive group): the seven archive workers, archive-acquired.ts,
claremont-nag-hammadi.mjs, books/[id]/archive-images/route.ts and split-book.mjs left —
each calls recountBook() once per book after its page writes. 68 → 57.
2026-10-17 (#6824): scripts/lib/translate-core.mjs left — syncBookTranslationCounters()
delegates to recountBook(), which also restamps translation_state. 57 → 56.
